constraints: no clinical, financial, record or real appointment mutation

criteria.title: Prompt provenance is exact and complete
criteria.target: The five received source files are byte-identical to the intake, hash-bound, and prior 14-source history remains intact.
criteria.evidence: SHA-256 manifest plus source files under docs/11_phase11/prompt-master/20260915-formal-closure/source/
criteria.validity: A changed or missing source invalidates the scope used to derive the certification contract.

criteria.title: Phase 11 is the sole current certification
criteria.target: certification/current.json resolves to a valid certification/phase11 package with matching commit, treeHash, candidateId, manifest and result hashes; Phase 10 is historical only.
criteria.evidence: current pointer verifier, phase11 manifest/result schemas, historical separation regression
criteria.validity: Prevents a stale or weaker historical certificate from being interpreted as current release truth.

criteria.title: Certification calculus is single and fail-closed
criteria.target: certify, verify and promotion check recompute one decision; false-GO, dirty, stale, hash mismatch and mandatory non-pass cases are rejected.
criteria.evidence: deterministic rules tests, mutation sentinels, re-computation of raw gates
criteria.validity: Rejects self-authenticating result fields and avoids score-based masking of hard failures.

criteria.title: Legacy production bypass is zero
criteria.target: All production-target entrypoints select the governed durable kernel or fail closed; legacy bypass call-sites are zero or explicitly test-only.
criteria.evidence: call-site inventory, architecture test, fail-closed startup test, public-path test
criteria.validity: Reachability at the production boundary matters more than the existence of a governed implementation elsewhere.

criteria.title: Replan preserves lineage and safe continuation
criteria.target: Plan v1 followed by a false evaluation produces Plan v2 with parentPlanId=v1, updated reason/evidence, bounded budget consumption and safe continuation.
criteria.evidence: public orchestration fixture and persisted memory/PostgreSQL tests
criteria.validity: Tests the actual replan boundary and prevents silent replacement or unsafe continuation.

criteria.title: Loop and budget controls survive restart
criteria.target: Repeated fingerprints terminate deterministically; step/replan/time/cost budgets deny or hand off at exhaustion and persisted usage survives worker restart.
criteria.evidence: loop detector, budget exhaustion, restart/recovery tests and raw metrics
criteria.validity: Protects against autonomous infinite work and in-memory budget resets.

criteria.title: Leases and claims are fenced
criteria.target: After lease expiry worker B takes over and worker A's stale heartbeat/ack/failure/effect settlement is denied; concurrent claims have one winner.
criteria.evidence: PostgreSQL and controlled worker takeover race with leaseToken and version checks
criteria.validity: A worker identity alone is insufficient protection after takeover.

criteria.title: Effect journal is idempotent and crash-aware
criteria.target: Crash after effect before acknowledgement yields duplicate effect count zero; confirmed/failed/unknown effects reconcile safely and ambiguous identity remains UNCERTAIN.
criteria.evidence: effect journal crash matrix, idempotency key tests, reconciliation report
criteria.validity: Protects irreversible side-effect boundaries even when process state is lost.

criteria.title: Complete durable lineage and tracing
criteria.target: Goal/Plan/Step/Attempt/Observation/Evaluation/Outbox/Effect/Audit records preserve tenant, correlation and trace relationships end to end.
criteria.evidence: lineage graph, schema constraints, public vertical trace and OTel/metrics evidence
criteria.validity: Allows reconstruction, audit and incident recovery across async boundaries.

criteria.title: Tenant and governance boundaries resist adversarial input
criteria.target: Cross-tenant reads/writes, untrusted actor identity, prompt/tool/model/replanner/RAG/channel injection and approval races fail closed with no data or effect leakage.
criteria.evidence: RLS/PostgreSQL isolation, API authorization, injection corpus, concurrency and red-team regressions
criteria.validity: The dangerous failures occur at trust and tenant boundaries, not in a benign unit fixture.

criteria.title: Real disposable PostgreSQL path is current
criteria.target: Migrations, transactions, recovery and isolation pass against a disposable PostgreSQL instance; absent infrastructure remains NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.
criteria.evidence: npm run test:postgres with recorded database identity and sanitized log
criteria.validity: In-memory stores cannot prove SQL constraints, locking, RLS or restart semantics.

criteria.title: Operator console is usable and safe
criteria.target: Active goals, plan/current step, budgets, replans, risk, approvals, failures, human ownership and dead letters are visible read-only with responsive, accessible states.
criteria.evidence: Playwright screenshot/state matrix, keyboard/focus/semantics checks and fresh visual critic
criteria.validity: A console can be logically correct yet unusable or unsafe at the operator boundary.

criteria.title: Supply-chain and static security evidence is current
criteria.target: Security, dependency, license, SBOM, secret scanning and available CodeQL/static checks pass or are explicitly recorded unavailable.
criteria.evidence: raw scanner logs and hash-bound reports
criteria.validity: Certification must not omit repository-level integrity and secret leakage risks.

criteria.title: External qualification is real and separate
criteria.target: Triple AAA requires real provider, channel, external identity, institutional RAG approval, physical durability/RPO-RTO, supervised pilot, rollback and human signoff; absent proof is blocked.
criteria.evidence: authorized environment records, provider/channel traces, RPO/RTO report, pilot report and human signoff
criteria.validity: Local fakes cannot establish operational authority or real-world safety.

criteria.title: Production remains protected
criteria.target: No production deploy, unrestricted release, real patient data or real appointment/clinical/financial/record mutation occurs in this round.
criteria.evidence: execution log, environment boundary, controlled adapter inventory and negative external-action audit
criteria.validity: The task is implementation and proof preparation, not authorization to act on real systems.
